generated_examples.rule: Each source row becomes one research-only example with the same official URL, fact, gate and confidence. No parcel accessibility, service frequency, station capacity, funding, transport-assessment outcome or planning permission is inferred.

second_pass_examples.rule: Each source row is rendered a second time as a fail-closed control. Dataset/tool/node presence remains separate from routed parcel access, service level and development readiness.

extra_examples.fact: DfT states Connectivity Tool scores are relative to the highest-scoring location, not an absolute accessibility percentage.
extra_examples.gate: Do not interpret score 60 as 60% accessible or directly compare scores across modes/destination types.

extra_examples.fact: The tool can model how transport interventions could alter connectivity.
extra_examples.gate: A modelled improvement is not a funded scheme, delivery commitment or planning mitigation package.

extra_examples.fact: 2026 LTP guidance requires transport and development to be aligned.
extra_examples.gate: Policy alignment does not prove a named development has secured transport infrastructure funding.

extra_examples.fact: Significant transport-generating developments may need a Transport Assessment or Statement.
extra_examples.gate: Requirement for assessment is not acceptance of transport impact or planning permission.

extra_examples.fact: TAG M3-1 emphasises fit-for-purpose highway assignment modelling.
extra_examples.gate: Modelled flow or delay is not observed network capacity without valid calibration and project-specific inputs.

extra_examples.fact: TAG M4 treats forecast uncertainty explicitly.
extra_examples.gate: A forecast demand scenario must not be stored as a guaranteed future traffic level.

extra_examples.fact: Local Authority Bus Grant allocations are authority-level capital/revenue funding envelopes.
extra_examples.gate: Do not assign an authority allocation to a parcel, route or stop without a named funded scheme.

extra_examples.fact: The transport-access-node dataset exposes NaPTAN points from the Department for Transport through Planning Data.
extra_examples.gate: Node inventory is appropriate for access-point discovery, not service frequency or route-quality inference.

extra_examples.fact: The railway-station entity is an authoritative point access node.
extra_examples.gate: A point is not a station catchment polygon and must not be buffered into parcel accessibility without a justified routing method.

extra_examples.fact: NaPTAN provides a station point, not a pedestrian route.
extra_examples.gate: Use actual walk/cycle/street-network routing before any parcel-distance threshold is applied.

extra_examples.fact: Multiple authoritative NaPTAN records can represent platforms, metro nodes or marked stops at the same interchange.
extra_examples.gate: Do not count nearby operational nodes as multiple independent destinations or duplicate accessibility benefit.

extra_examples.fact: The authoritative record identifies a tram platform point.
extra_examples.gate: Platform geometry alone does not encode headway, operating hours, interchange time or crowding.

extra_examples.fact: Enhanced partnerships coordinate local authorities and operators to improve bus services.
extra_examples.gate: Partnership existence is not a guarantee that a target site has a frequent or direct bus service.

extra_examples.fact: Current cross-agency guidance supports environmental pre-application advice for transport and construction developers.
extra_examples.gate: Advice is separate from planning permission, environmental permits and other statutory consents.

extra_examples.fact: PINS says the new-style examination collection applies to plans submitted on or after 31 December 2026.
extra_examples.gate: Do not apply the new examination route to a plan without checking its exact submission route and date.

extra_examples.fact: The 2026 implementation plan links infrastructure reform to national housing and economic objectives.
extra_examples.gate: National delivery targets do not establish a specific parcel's infrastructure timing, consent or uplift.
